strings.txt_pvp_rule:
1.Cycle of solving group:
Ranked each season <1 month long>, the results are calculated according to the rating at the end of the season. All players participating in the ranking will receive Gems according to the order in the <general leaderboard>. In addition, each time you level up, the player will receive the corresponding reward in the <promotion reward> section.
2. Game rules:
Each match system will arrange <5 opponents> corresponding to the player's rank and level. Players need to kill enemies quickly, collect items to achieve high scores.
3. Law of ranking:
There are 10 ranks in the prize pool: <Herald, Guardian, Crusader, Archon, Legend, Ancient, Divine, Immortal, Eternal, God>. In which, the <Herald, Guardian> tiers include <3 groups from III to I>, the <Crusader, Archon> ranks include <4 groups from IV to I>, the higher ranks include <5 groups from V to I> .
Winning when owning enough stars will help you move up to the next level or team. Failure when you run out of stars and points will cause you to be demoted or your team. The <Herald III> tier will no longer be deducted when the points are exhausted.
